benchmark_selection_basis: simulator-only validity; no FastWAM inference has been run on any move_block_reveal_can version
bug_classification: pre-policy scripted-expert trajectory corrections only; task scene, sampling, conditions, seeds, camera, horizon, visibility, instruction, and success predicate are unchanged from V0.3.4/V0.3.5
reason: V0.3.5 reset passed all paired-state/visibility assertions, but expert passed 5/9 cells. Three deterministic simulator-only causes were isolated. The block carried during rearward transfer sagged about 5.008 mm, leaving the unchanged AABB clearance boundary short by 8.164 micrometers; V0.3.6 uses a 10 mm command buffer while preserving the 50 mm clearance and 2 mm validation tolerance. After release, the end effector was already near z=1.096 m and an unnecessary +0.10 m retreat was unreachable; it now returns directly to the native home pose. Finally, the native alternate can path releases from height and depends on uncontrolled tumbling; it is replaced only in the scripted expert by a seed-independent insertion pose computed from basket geometry and the measured EE-to-can grasp transform. No task geometry or condition was changed and no policy result exists.
instruction: Put the can into the basket.

occluder.implementation: one dynamic rigid actor with procedural opaque body and grasp cap, matching visual/collision geometry

conditions.shared_base: all conditions construct and settle the block at occluding_pose through the same fixed-seed path
conditions.visible: before first policy observation, move only block to revealed_pose, zero velocity, advance five physics steps
conditions.missing: leave block at occluding_pose, advance the same five physics steps, no intervention
conditions.oracle_reveal: start exactly as missing; before first policy observation apply the exact visible block-only intervention

visibility.missing: zero can pixels independently in head, left wrist, and right wrist
visibility.visible_and_oracle: at least one policy camera contains at least 32 can pixels
visibility.block: at least 32 pixels in at least one policy camera

task_configuration.success: can projected full AABB laterally contained by basket metadata bounds; can center vertically inside conservative placement range; basket upright; can contacts basket; can-side gripper open; can contacts neither gripper; relative can/basket motion below fixed thresholds for 25 actual physics steps; block ignored; check_success pure

scripted_expert.visible_and_oracle: native grasp followed by basket-frame center insertion, release, retreat, home, persistent settle
scripted_expert.missing: compound block reveal, direct return home, then identical center insertion
scripted_expert.meaningful_contact: any point with signed separation <= 0 or applied impulse norm > 0
scripted_expert.can_insertion_target: basket local horizontal center; local vertical center = basket bottom + projected can half-height + 0.005 m; orientation and EE-to-can grasp transform preserved

exact_block_reveal_calibration.instruction: Move the block aside to reveal the can.
exact_block_reveal_calibration.success: same frozen Missing scene/block; block translated >=0.08 m, can visible, block released and not in meaningful contact with can, block stable for 25 physics steps; can placement not scored
